description: High Quality LED Light: The LED technology integrated in EMERALD Emergency Torch is a uniquely developed solution by Wipro. While instantly turned on, it enables an optimal light output and makes your home bright Sharp light beam: Emerald Led rechargeable torch comes with a sharp light beam which gives a more intense and focused light beam which makes searching and looking at longer distance easier- giving better visibility in focused area with minimum spillage. Sturdy and Durable: The polycarbonate material of this Wipro emergency light gives it a tough and resilient exterior, making it a great addition to your home for years to come. The durable nature of this rechargeable light also protects it against wear and tear. Lighting Modes: This rechargeable LED light hosts a one-button operation design, making it one of the best torch lights, as you can power on/off and switch between the 2 brightness levels with one simple thumb swipe. There are 2 modes of lighting i.e. High brightness headlamp, low brightness head lamp. Rechargeable Battery: it comes with a high-quality rechargeable battery of 3.7V,3000 mAH Lithium-Ion battery Charging & Backup Time: Emerald comes with 2-pin plug,which is compatible with even a 3-pin socket, allowing you to charge with ease. Emarald emergency torch take up to 14-16 hours to completely charge and gives up to 7 hours of backup Ergonomic Design : It’s lightweight, compact design makes it convenient and effortless to carry from one place to another Warranty : 6 Months
